title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Admissions Fraud
It is your responsibility to ensure that your application information is
truthful, complete, and correct. If any information in your application is
determined to be false or misleading, concealed or withheld, your application
may be invalid and this could result in immediate refusal of further admission
consideration, or revocation of an offer of admission and de-registration in
all
courses
at Laurier.
Students
are required to produce documentation
verifying their identity, once on campus.
